caseName: United States Parole Commission v. Shepard
caseNameFull: United States Parole Commission v. Shepard

opinions.text: Appeal from C. A. 2d Cir. Motion of appellee for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Judgment vacated and case remanded for further consideration in light of Moody v. Daggett, ante, p, 78, and to consider whether case is moot.
